name: ctp-bot
description: remake of the calamity texture pack bot

scripts.fetch: wget https://github.com/Altalyra/CalamityTexturePack/releases/latest/download/CalamityTexturePack.zip -qO CalamityTexturePack.zip && unzip -qo CalamityTexturePack.zip -d ./archive && mv ./archive/CalamityTexturePack/* ./archive && rmdir ./archive/CalamityTexturePack
scripts.update:Windows: git fetch && git checkout v2.0 && git add ./prisma && git commit -m "PackDB Update to '%npm_config_var%'" && git push origin v2.0
scripts.update:Linux: git fetch && git checkout v2.0 && git add ./prisma && git commit -m "PackDB Update to '${npm_config_var}'" && git push origin v2.0
